items.title: Three megawatt large-scale battery in operation since 2016
items.summary: For over 100 years, the run-of-river power plant of the Norwegian energy company Statkraft in Dörverden on the Middle Weser has been reliably supplying renewable electricity. In 2016, the power plant at the site received a powerful addition in the form of a modern large-scale lithium-ion battery from ADS-TEC Energy, which has since been providing important grid services with three megawatts of power at the local grid connection. It is the first large battery in Germany that was put out to tender without subsidies. It was produced in Dresden at the high-tech manufacturing site of the battery specialist ADS-TEC Energy from Baden-Württemberg.

items.title: Ultra-fast charging at the Energie Steiermark headquarters
items.summary: With two ultra-fast charging columns directly in front of the main entrance to the company headquarters in Graz, Energie Steiermark is reaffirming its claim to leadership in the field of e-mobility: with up to 320 kilowatts, the system charges electric cars of customers, visitors and employees in a matter of minutes. Installation is possible at normal grid connections and is therefore inexpensive, unbureaucratic and even possible in residential areas.

items.title: New standards for electromobility in urban areas
items.summary: Aral uses ultra-fast charging system ChargeBox from ADS-TEC Energy in the heart of Berlin. Charging in minutes with up to 320 kilowatts of power despite low grid capacity - thanks to battery-buffered ChargeBox from ADS-TEC Energy.

items.title: Porsche driving event at TEAG in Erfurt
items.summary: How does fast charging work on the road - that was the topic of a three-day electric driving event with four Porsche Taycans and around 80 participants on the campus of TEAG (TEAG Thüringer Energie AG) in Erfurt from 27 July 2020. The High Power Charging Event was organised by the Porsche Centre Erfurt with the support of TEAG as a customer event with test charging at the newly installed ultra-fast charging station ChargeBox from ADS-TEC Energy. The aim of the event was to make the topic tangible for potential customers and interested parties and to convey how uncomplicated and simple ultra-fast charging can be. It became clear how close a charging process comes to the conventional refuelling process in terms of time and what advantages this new technology has to offer beyond that.

items.title: Strong partners for the expansion of charging infrastructure at filling stations
items.summary: • JOLT and ADS-TEC Energy drive the introduction of battery-buffered fast charging stations in urban areas • JOLT plans to install 5,000 ultra-fast ADS-TEC Energy charging stations in Europe and the USA by 2027 • Installation at filling stations has already begun in Germany: JOLT's first stations are successfully in operation at an ESSO station in Hamburg and Stuttgart • JOLT is planning 120 ultra-fast charging points from ADS-TEC Energy at 60 ESSO locations in major German cities

items.title: ChargePost with PV carport at Netto in North Rhine-Westphalia
items.summary: The specialist planning office amperio and solar equipment supplier CLIMOVA have been developing innovative e-mobility concepts for the energy transition since 2023. Together, the two "future power companies", as ADS-TEC Energy calls such new players in the energy transition, are able to provide holistic energy solutions - in this case consisting of a PV system, battery storage and charging infrastructure. Ultra-fast charging is combined with self-generated energy. PV systems become a worthwhile investment, as customers benefit from additional income through the provision of their roof space and can use the low-cost solar power on site themselves. They do not have to worry about installation and service - the operators take care of that.

items.title: Flexibility for renewables and mobility in Ludwigsburg
items.summary: Since 2018, the outdoor battery system with 120 kilowatt hours of capacity and 120 kilowatts of power has been successfully in use in a holistic smart grid project for the decentralised energy supply of the predominantly commercially used urban district urbanharbor. Based on renewable energies and combined heat and power, it ensures a balance between generation and consumption and serves as a buffer for e-mobility.
